definitions.explanation: An adult female human. Also used as a prefix to indicate female gender of various things.

examples.japanese: あの{女|おんな}の{人|ひと}は{誰|だれ}ですか？
examples.notes: 女の人 is more polite than 女 alone

examples.japanese: {女|おんな}の{子|こ}が{三人|さんにん}います。
トイレは{男|おとこ}と{女|おんな}に{分|わ}かれています。
examples.english: The toilets are divided into male and female.

notes: When referring to people politely, use {女|おんな}の{人|ひと} (woman) or {女性|じょせい} (female, more formal). {女|おんな}の{子|こ} means 'girl'. The kanji {女|おんな} is also read as じょ in compounds like {女性|じょせい}. Opposite: {男|おとこ} (man).
